introspection_query_lines: WITH target AS (
SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')
AND c.relname IN ('plans','plan_history','tasks','executions','completion_events','request_receipts','reviews')
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'schema_version',1,'project_id','yynsaokvquggrbdrmalr','engine','PostgreSQL',
'introspected_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
'source','Supabase execute_sql; read-only pg_catalog and pg_policies introspection after optimize_t06_diary migration',
'public_table_names',(SELECT jsonb_agg(c.relname ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')),
'tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
'name',t.relname,'schema','public','rls_enabled',t.relrowsecurity,'rls_forced',t.relforcerowsecurity,

'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'nullable',NOT a.attnotnull,'primary_key',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint pk WHERE pk.conrelid=t.oid AND pk.contype='p' AND a.attnum=ANY(pk.conkey)),'default',pg_get_expr(ad.adbin,ad.adrelid),'ordinal_position',a.attnum) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid=a.attrelid AND ad.adnum=a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),

'constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',k.conname,'type',CASE k.contype WHEN 'p' THEN 'PRIMARY KEY' WHEN 'f' THEN 'FOREIGN KEY' WHEN 'u' THEN 'UNIQUE' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CHECK' ELSE k.contype::text END,'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY ord) FROM unnest(k.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS cols(num,ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=k.conrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num),'references',CASE WHEN k.contype='f' THEN jsonb_build_object('schema',(SELECT n.nspname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.oid=k.confrelid),'table',(SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE oid=k.confrelid),'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY ord) FROM unnest(k.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS cols(num,ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=k.confrelid AND a.attnum=cols.num)) ELSE NULL END,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true),'validated',k.convalidated,'deferrable',k.condeferrable,'initially_deferred',k.condeferred,'on_delete',CASE k.confdeltype WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION' WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE' WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL' WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT' ELSE NULL END,'on_update',CASE k.confupdtype WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION' WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE' WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL' WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT' ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY k.conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=t.oid),

'indexes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',ic.relname,'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid,cols.ord::integer,true) ORDER BY cols.ord) FROM unnest(i.indkey::smallint[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS cols(num,ord)),'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'method',am.amname,'predicate',pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)) ORDER BY ic.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=ic.relam WHERE i.indrelid=t.oid),

'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.policyname,'permissive',p.permissive,'roles',p.roles,'command',p.cmd,'using',p.qual,'with_check',p.with_check) ORDER BY p.policyname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policies p WHERE p.schemaname='public' AND p.tablename=t.relname),

'public_role_privileges',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',g.grantee,'privilege',g.privilege_type,'grantable',g.is_grantable) ORDER BY g.grantee,g.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM information_schema.role_table_grants g WHERE g.table_schema='public' AND g.table_name=t.relname AND g.grantee IN ('anon','authenticated'))
) ORDER BY t.relname) FROM target t),

'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',g.tgname,'table_name',t.relname,'enabled',g.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(g.oid,true),'function',(SELECT p.proname FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid=g.tgfoid)) ORDER BY t.relname,g.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger g JOIN target t ON t.oid=g.tgrelid WHERE NOT g.tgisinternal),

'functions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'schema','public','identity_arguments',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'result_type',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'language',l.lanname,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'security_mode',CASE WHEN p.prosecdef THEN 'DEFINER' ELSE 'INVOKER' END,'settings',coalesce(to_jsonb(p.proconfig),'[]'::jsonb),'volatility',CASE p.provolatile WHEN 'i' THEN 'IMMUTABLE' WHEN 's' THEN 'STABLE' ELSE 'VOLATILE' END,'anon_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) ORDER BY p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname LIKE 'pds_%')
) AS catalog;
